test_dataframe_plot_line_colors: test DataFrame.plot line colors with single string, list, hex, or RGB tuple color arguments
test_dataframe_plot_bar_colors: test DataFrame.plot.bar colors with single color, list of colors, or colormap argument
test_dataframe_plot_scatter_c_column: test DataFrame.plot.scatter color mapping using a column name via the c parameter
test_dataframe_plot_box_dict_colors: test DataFrame.plot.box with dict-based color assignment for boxes, whiskers, medians, and caps
test_dataframe_plot_area_colors: test DataFrame.plot.area colors with custom color list or colormap and stacked parameter
